people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.
translations.bsb: For You have established Your people Israel as Your very own forever, and You, O LORD, have become their God.
translations.kjv: For thou hast confirmed to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever: and thou, LORD, art become their God.
translations.asv: And thou didst establish to thyself thy people Israel to be a people unto thee for ever; and thou, Jehovah, becamest their God.
